name: go-generate-inputs
description: A go:generate directive whose command is a generator the analysis knows names that generator's inputs, and each declaration it names is a root, because deleting it breaks go generate: the types a stringer directive lists, after a boolean flag too, the interfaces a mockgen directive lists after the package it reads them from, and every interface of the file a mockgen directive reads as its source, a double-quoted file name being one word as go generate splits it. An interface no directive names is reported.
